messages:
mira: Tiny watercooler q: what was the first podcast that made you cancel other plans and keep listening? share ep or one-liner! :coffee:

ben: Hardcore History 'The Destroyer of Worlds' preview? my train commute vanished. insane storytelling.

zoe: Therapy for Black Girls ep on boundaries 30F60A made me actually set a 'no work calls after 7' rule. life-changing.

raju: Reply All early ep about the spam farm. taught me to be paranoid in good ways. :detective:

katie: 99% Invisible 'Designing the Impossible' F3A4 soundscapes + tiny details = obsessed. link: https://99percentinvisible.org/

echo-bot: Suggested tag: #commute-essentials based on activity in this thread

mira: Nice spread. quick poll: pick one category and one ep to recommend to someone who wants to try podcasts but hates long forms.

ben: short-narrative: Reply All ep 'The Pitch' (short, sharp)

zoe: self-help: Therapy for Black Girls ep on boundaries (easy to digest)

raju: curiosity: 99% Invisible ep about maps (~20-30 mins)

katie: comedy: Conan O'Brien Needs A Friend F609 pick any ~40-min interview

mira: Thanks! saving these for a friend who's been podcast-curious. :sparkles:
